decisions: D-03 is fixed: drafts make no durability claim; Saved on this Mac appears only after atomic SQLite projection/outbox COMMIT; Synced appears only after exact acknowledgement matching mutation identity and fingerprint.
electron@44.1.1 and zod@4.5.4 were explicitly approved and installed.
Lockfile regeneration for the existing @tailwindcss/vite@4.3.3 was explicitly approved.
better-sqlite3 was not approved or installed; packaged node:sqlite passed and remains the selected implementation.
The selected user-data profile owns Electron's single-instance lock before bootstrap; isolated profiles stay independent and duplicate ownership of one profile is rejected.

The synchronization namespace contract was expanded additively to five server-derived fields: issuer, origin, stable server instance, account subject, and synchronization generation. Clients cannot assert, reconstruct, or override namespace authority.
Desktop sync is bounded pull-before-push and preserves exact serialized command bytes for retries.
Sign-out fences local intent and clears credentials before best-effort remote revocation.
GSD project runtime is Claude with the adaptive role-based model profile; current executor and verifier resolve to Sonnet.

environment.isolation_note: No git remote, so origin/HEAD is unresolvable and worktree.base-check returns shouldDegrade:true / fork-ref-unknown. GSD sequential fallback is correct (#683). Do NOT force worktree dispatch and do NOT create a remote. dispatch-isolation re-resolves to harness-worktree on every read and re-persists it, so re-arm before EVERY dispatch: gsd-tools query dispatch-isolation --raw --phase KPL-03 --force-isolation none. Without this the isolation guard hook refuses the Agent() call. Do not set workflow.use_worktrees=false as a workaround.
environment.harness_note: pnpm test:desktop -- <name> does NOT filter: the extra -- makes vitest ignore the positional, so the full desktop suite runs whatever name is passed. Counts from it are not lane-scoped. Do not edit committed plan verify commands to 'fix' this.

open_items.item: 03-04 native shell built but not wired into the shipped app
open_items.detail: main/menu.ts, main/windows/{main-window,quick-entry-window,settings-window}.ts and preload/utility-preload.ts are production-quality and E2E-proven, but apps/desktop/main/index.ts contains zero references to them (verified by grep). They are proven against a deliberately-labeled test-only Electron entry point (apps/desktop/test/fixtures/wired-app-harness.ts) that composes the same production modules, NOT against the shipped dist/main/index.cjs. Until bootstrap() in main/index.ts calls createMainWindow / buildApplicationMenu / QuickEntryWindowController / SettingsWindowController, no user can reach Command-N, the global shortcut, Quick Entry, or the native menus. Cause: main/index.ts is not in 03-04's files_modified but is required by its deliverable - a planning defect the wave-7 scope fence surfaced rather than created. Assign the wiring to Plan 03-11 (wave 8): it depends_on 03-04, owns main/index.ts, and is already the window/lifecycle plan. Do NOT give it to 03-10; sealing the hostile boundary is unrelated and that would expand its scope.
